name: FREAK
source:
FREAK is a short sound novel where you sit in Small's POV, with nothing else but you,  your claw, a latex suit, and a room with loud lights. 

[From [url=https://gnomescourt.itch.io/freak]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《FREAK》是一部有声短篇小说，你坐在斯莫尔的第一视角中，除了你、你的爪子、乳胶套装和一间灯光明亮的房间外，什么都没有。

[来自[url=https://gnomescourt.itch.io/freak]Itch.io[/url]]
